title: You’re not just thinking wrong…
paragraphs:
You’re not just thinking wrong…
You’re believing lies that are slowly destroying you.
You don’t even feel it anymore.

Because those thoughts?
They sound like your own voice now.

They feel normal.
Reasonable.
Even… justified.
But what if I told you—

Some of the thoughts you trust the most
are the very ones keeping you bound?
Because this isn’t just about thinking better.
This is about being set free.
Stopped believing God would even look your way.

You smile in public—
but inside?

Conviction came—
but you muted it.

God called—
but you delayed it.

Not because you're at peace—
but because you've gotten used to ignoring His voice.
So you fed the very thing that’s starving your soul.
You said: “This is just who I am.”
So you built an identity around your struggle.

You accepted chains
that Jesus already broke.

Romans 8:1
“There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.”

2 Corinthians 6:2
“Now is the day of salvation.”

James 1:14–15
“Each person is tempted when he is lured and enticed by his own desire. Then desire when it has conceived gives birth to sin, and sin when it is fully grown brings forth death.”

2 Corinthians 5:17
“If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.”

Hebrews 4:13
“Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight.”
The thoughts you’d never say out loud.
And here’s the part religion doesn’t always tell you clearly enough—

He sees it…
and still makes a way for you.
“Fix yourself so God will accept you.”

You have sinned.
I have sinned.
All of us have fallen short.
Romans 3:23 — “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.”
But God didn’t leave you there.

Romans 5:8
“But God shows His love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.”
While you were still in it.
Jesus Christ stepped into your mess.
Lived the life you couldn’t live.

And rose again—
so your story wouldn’t end in sin.

Your sin is real.
But His grace is greater.

Your past is heavy.
But His cross is heavier.

Your shame is loud.
But His love is louder.
This is the moment to respond.
Stop normalizing what is killing you.
Say it—even if your voice shakes:
If you come to Him like that?

John 6:37
“Whoever comes to Me I will never cast out.”
But because truth just confronted you.
If this hit your heart, don’t ignore it.
Come back when the lies get loud again.
If this stirred something in you…
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
